title: Settings
editor_full_width_hint: When on, the editor body fills the panel's full width. Same value as the width toggle in the editor toolbar.
spellcheck_enabled_hint: The OS/WebView's built-in spelling underline. Same value as the spell-check button in the editor toolbar.
close_blocked_busy: The settings window can't be closed until the data operation finishes.
briefing_when_launch: When the app starts (first time each day)
briefing_evening_hint: Only shown if the app is running within 3 hours of the set time.
briefing_off_reason: Turn on the briefing to change this
briefing_notify_hint: If app notifications are off, the window opens instead.

ai_debug_verbose: Record prompt/response text in the AI call log (debug)

ai_search_placeholder: Search features by name or description...

ai_policy_level_hint: Features above this level are blocked automatically. Lowering it never clears the toggles below — raise the level again and your earlier choices come back.
ai_action_edit_hint: AI preset names and prompts are edited on their own page.
sheet_opacity_hint: Lower values let more of the desktop show through and can reduce text readability.

collect_ai_post_process_notice: AI Post-Processing: AI generates organization & tag suggestions for each collected note.
collect_post_process_summary_hint: Summarizes the day's prompts into a short summary at the top of the note. Only prompts are sent, never replies.

collect_post_process_prompt_hint: Custom instructions applied when post-processing collected notes.

collect_browser_open_tabs_hint: Open tabs are only recorded after you close them.

attachment_storage_mode_hint: Copies files into Brise storage so they remain safe even if the original is moved or deleted.
attachment_storage_mode_reference_warn: ⚠️ Warning: If the original file is deleted or moved, the attachment cannot be opened.
collect_run_now_disabled_dry_run: Dry-run sources can't be run now — use Test Fetch instead.
collect_row_disabled_hint: This source is off — automatic collection skips it.
data_location_split_hint: Attachments and backups only — the notes database stays on this PC.
data_location_restart_note: Brise will copy your data and restart. The data at the old location stays as-is.
data_location_error_not_writable: Brise can't write to this folder. Please choose another one.
data_location_error_existing_data: This folder already has other Brise data in it. Please choose another one.
import_version_newer: This file was created by a newer version of Brise. Update the app, then try again.

backup_excluded_refs: {{n}} referenced attachment(s) are not included in this backup — their originals stay where they are.

import_mode_hint: Choose how the bundle joins your library. “Notebook” is the top-level unit (folders + notes + regions).
import_choice_add_notebook_hint: Creates a fresh notebook with new ids — safe to import the same file twice.
import_choice_hash_merge_hint: Skips notes whose title + body already match; different content is added as new notes by default.
import_hash_update_existing: When merging: update notes that share a title (instead of adding new)
import_choice_replace_hint: Wipes this library and rebuilds it from the bundle. Destructive.
phrase_packs_hint: A line or two at the top of the Briefing window. Choose a pack or turn it off.
phrase_pack_ai_title: Create a phrase pack with AI
phrase_pack_ai_hint: Give a topic and AI writes {{count}} phrases. Preview them, then save to start using the pack.
phrase_pack_ai_topic_placeholder: e.g. stoic quotes, gentle morning lines
phrase_pack_ai_failed: No response from AI. Please try again in a moment.
phrase_pack_ai_parse_failed: Could not find a phrase list in the response. Try a different topic or regenerate.
dashboard_top_tabs_hint: Choose which dashboard tabs are visible and in what order.
dashboard_sidebar_hint: Choose which sidebar filter modes are visible and in what order.

sync_tailscale_dialog_desc: Install and sign in to Tailscale to securely connect from phones or other PCs on the same tailnet.
test_db_off_desc: Creates a "테스트 DB" notebook filled with sample notes of every type. Your real data is untouched.
test_db_on_desc: The "테스트 DB" notebook exists. Deleting it removes all notes inside.
sync_server_down_warning: Sync server isn't running right now.

reorder_keyboard_hint: Use ← → to reorder and Space to turn a tab on or off.
reorder_last_enabled: At least one tab has to stay on.
sync_regenerate_confirm: A new token disconnects all connected devices (phones, browser tabs). They'll need the new address or QR code to reconnect.
sync_port_restart_hint: A changed port takes effect after you turn sync off and on again.
sync_port_restart_needed: Port saved. Turn sync off and on again to reopen on the new port.
sync_port_invalid: The port must be a number between 1024 and 65535.
sync_no_tailscale_warning: No Tailscale interface found — only this PC can access it for now. Install Tailscale to reach it from other devices on the same tailnet.
sync_hint: Requires Tailscale. Only devices on the same tailnet can connect. Open the URL above in a phone browser.
sync_qr_caption: Scan with your phone camera to open it instantly
sync_steps_hint: ① Install the Tailscale app on your phone and sign in with the same account ② Scan this QR or enter the URL ③ You can edit too
pet_capture_screenshot: Add screen capture to the tray menu
pet_capture_screenshot_hint: Adds "Save screen" to the tray menu (and to the pet's right-click menu when the pet is on — they are the same menu). It captures the active window and saves a PNG to the capture folder, even when the pet is off. With the pet on, a card asks which note to add it to; with the pet off, it goes straight into a new inbox note. Only on the pet card path, when AI is enabled, is the image first sent to your configured AI provider for a summary (the pet-off path never summarizes).
close_to_tray_hint: Keep Brise running in background when closed.
date_nudge_mode_hint: Choose how a detected date or time is handled: Auto-register saves it immediately without asking (undo still applies); Suggest only shows a confirm chip first. Off turns this suggestion off, but you can still register one directly via the `/` menu's Date command.
region_nudge_mode_hint: When a registered place name is detected, Strict only suggests it when the name stands alone as a word; Loose also suggests it inside other words. Off turns this suggestion off, but you can still register one directly via the `/` menu's Region command.
paste_link_nudge_hint: When you paste a lone URL, offers to fetch that page's body. The AI link-summary suggestion is configured separately on the AI pages.
paste_path_inline_code_hint: When you paste a lone file path, wraps it in inline code formatting automatically.
paste_table_sheet_suggest_label: Suggest turning tables into a sheet
paste_table_sheet_suggest_hint: When you paste tab- or comma-shaped table text, offers to turn it into a sheet.
editor_md_autoformat_hint: As you type, converts Markdown syntax like `# `, `- `, `- [ ] `, `> `, `**bold**` into rich formatting right away. Off leaves the characters literal. Shortcuts, toolbar buttons, and pasting Markdown are unaffected either way.
link_open_on_click_hint: Choose how links open. With Click, a plain click opens the link immediately, so placing the caret inside a link needs the arrow keys. Note links (`[[…]]`) are unaffected either way.
editor_width_hint: The maximum width of the note body: Narrow / Normal (default, 800px) / Wide. The body stays left-aligned.
editor_width_disabled_reason: Unused while Full-width view is on — the body always fills the panel then.
editor_word_count_hint: The character and word count in the status bar below the editor. With a selection, it shows the selection’s counts.
new_note_date_precision_hint: New notes get today's date at this precision. You can always change a note's date later.
new_note_section_name_hint: The name of a new note's first section. Leave it blank to use the built-in default name.
notifications_needs_tray: Notifications won't arrive if the app is closed
pet_needs_tray: The pet disappears if the app is closed

pet_action_chat_disabled_hint: If AI is off, the main window opens instead of chat.
chat_memory_hint: Things the chatbot always remembers about you during conversations (up to 50 items).

chat_memory_full_reason: Memory is full ({{max}} items). Delete one from the list below to add another.

chat_perm_read_files_hint: Searches notes, folders, and sources in the workspace to assist responses.
chat_perm_write_notes_hint: Allows the chatbot to create or edit notes during conversation.

chat_perm_collect_register_hint: Registers web links or feeds as collection sources directly from chat.
